source_facts: Resize decision uses three bucket-count samples; full sample covers up to 128 buckets.
optimal_capacity can double capacity when sample indicates enlargement.
Incremental rehash links the old array, with deferred reclamation.
observations: Both frozen arms switch between lower and higher Feed minor-fault/HWM regimes for the same complete count set.
Parallel Feed source, default hash policy and extraction Vec are identical across arms.
First four-worker Chinese ByteLevel slowdown splits into Feed +0.7708s and Train +1.0753s; later full pairs are faster.
inference: Near-threshold sampled expansion/reclamation and process-random layout are plausible existing sources of allocation and time variability. Actual table capacity/resize events were not instrumented; neither a specific resize nor VPS-only causality is claimed.
